teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: phone number, mobile, email, address, street, city, postcode, contact, card, number, zero, oh, double

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
phone number, mobile, email, address, street, city, postcode, contact, card, number, zero, oh, double
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What's your phone number? (asking phone number)
• My phone number is... (giving phone number)
• What's your email address? (asking email)
• It's alex@email.com (giving email address)
• Where do you live? (asking address)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Digit grouping in phone numbers (3-3-4 rhythm). Dictating '@' as /æt/ and '.' as /dɒt/.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Digit grouping in phone numbers (3-3-4 rhythm). Dictating '@' as /æt/ and '.' as /dɒt/.

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Question words (What, Where, Who) + 'be' + possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their).

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Question words (What, Where, Who) + 'be' + possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their).
Examples:

• What is your phone number?
• My number is 555-0192.
• What is her email?
• Her email is sara@net.com.
• Where is your address?
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: What's your phone number?
Person B: My phone number is...
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can exchange contact information including phone numbers, email addresses, and home addresses.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Phone Number Dictation; 10-25m Contact Vocab & Symbols (@, .); 25-40m Possessive Adjectives & Wh- Questions Grammar; 40-55m Business Card Exchange; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-25m Vocab & Symbol Dictations; 25-45m Grammar Drills; 45-65m Speed-Networking Contact Swap; 65-85m Form Filling & Registration Text; 85-90m Summary.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Digit Rhythm Lab; 40-70m Grammar System; 70-100m Hotel Registration & Conference Directory Simulation; 100-115m Writing Directory; 115-120m Summary.
